sections.heading: Where to Launch
sections.body: Based on the affinity index, the top three cities for **Long Haul** are **Istanbul** with a spawn score of 1.21 and high confidence [q55], **Delhi** with a spawn score of 1.12 and high confidence [q59], and **Warsaw** with a spawn score of 1.12 and high confidence [q31].

sections.heading: Who the Players Are
sections.body: The audience skews male by +37.1% and female by -37.1% [q75]. Age skews include +1.8% for 35-44, -5.7% for 24 and under, -10.5% for 25-29, -14.6% for 30-34, -28.9% for 45-54, and -21.4% for 55+ [q75].

sections.heading: Who to Partner With
sections.body: Potential partners include artists **Jaroslav Beck**, **FamilyJules**, **Mick Gordon**, **Mike Ault**, and **Friedrich Habetler** [q76]. Brand partnerships could include **Newegg**, **Digital Storm Online**, **ASTRO Gaming**, **Turtle Beach**, and **EVGA Corporation** [q79].

sections.heading: How to Split the Budget
sections.body: From a total budget of $5,000.00, allocate 21.34% ($1,066.79) to **Istanbul** [q55], 19.82% ($991.03) to **Delhi** [q59], and 19.71% ($985.75) to **Warsaw** [q31].

sections.heading: Caveats
sections.body: The game is compared to **Farming Simulator 22**, **SnowRunner**, and **BeamNG.drive** [q1]. Similar titles include **Wreckfest**, **Project CARS 3**, **American Truck Simulator**, **SpinTires**, **The Crew 2**, **Need for Speed Heat**, **Forza Horizon 4**, and **Microsoft Flight Simulator** [q2].

limits: Affinity index, not a sales forecast.
Qloo measures taste affinity from consumption data, not sales or wishlists.
New indie games are usually not in Qloo yet, so the plan works through comparable games.
City-level results cannot be validated with free public data.
Brands are global: Qloo brand affinity ignores location.
Spawn score = taste lift x platform fit x culture fit, all from Qloo heatmaps.

Accuracy: on held-out games with no real-world setting, an LLM without Qloo data found the top country (by Google Trends) more often than this ranking, which has a city-level bias. It does better when the game has a real-world setting. A Steam-review backtest on 6 shipped games also lost to plain popularity. Numbers: docs/scenario-results.md and docs/backtest-results.md.
Treat the ranking as a taste-informed starting hypothesis and test it with small campaigns.
Launch actions: languages come from a static table, not Qloo. The geo-target radius is the one Qloo's heatmap used.
